reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited § 14.16 'Freedom of Action' affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to contract with others, supporting the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer).
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged.

Deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains; rationale accurately accounts for the other 'exclusive'/'sole' occurrences as unrelated (tax-exclusive charges, warranty disclaimer, nonexclusive licenses, 'sole discretion').
